description: Fresh random sample from entire course - independent verification round
systematic_issues: English-influenced word order: conditionals/time clauses placed after main clause instead of before (Chinese pattern: condition/time THEN main clause)
Awkward collocations: phrases like '问题的东西', '中文做得好', '会发生' that don't match natural Chinese usage
Incomplete translations: some English meanings lost (e.g., 'more' omitted, 'everything' missing)
Negation patterns: '不在试着' instead of correct '没在试着' or '不是在试着'

phrases.english: He wants to meet people who speak Chinese tomorrow at six o'clock.
phrases.other: 他想明天六点见说中文的人。
phrases.qa_notes: Good time placement (明天六点 before verb), natural relative clause structure

phrases.english: How much more time does your father need?
phrases.other: 你爸爸需要更多多少时间？
phrases.qa_notes: Awkward: '更多多少' is redundant/unnatural. Should be '还需要多少时间' or '需要多多少时间'

phrases.english: This is a good way to do this if we continue for a while.
phrases.other: 这是做这个的好方法如果我们继续一会儿。
phrases.qa_notes: MAJOR ISSUE: Very English-influenced. In Chinese, conditionals come BEFORE main clause. Should be '如果我们继续一会儿，这是做这个的好方法。'

phrases.english: I want to try to explain my meaning after you finish speaking.
phrases.other: 我想在你说完以后试着解释我的意思。
phrases.qa_notes: Good structure, time clause before main clause, 说完 correctly uses 完 as result complement

phrases.english: My friend answered all the questions this morning.
phrases.other: 我的朋友今天早上回答了所有的问题。
phrases.qa_notes: Excellent: time (今天早上) before verb, proper use of perfective 了

phrases.english: That is why he did not know the answer today.
phrases.other: 那就是为什么他今天不知道答案。
phrases.qa_notes: Natural structure, time placement correct within embedded clause

phrases.english: No problem. Everything is okay.
phrases.other: 没问题。一切都好。
phrases.qa_notes: Simple, natural, idiomatic expressions

phrases.english: Why is it useful to speak better before you take too much time?
phrases.other: 为什么在你花太多时间之前说得更好是有用的？
phrases.qa_notes: Awkward and English-influenced phrasing. Structure is confusing, subject unclear

phrases.english: Soon she will be nearly ready to help us learn her name.
phrases.other: 很快她快要帮我们学她的名字了。
phrases.qa_notes: Missing 'ready' (准备好). '学她的名字' is semantically odd. '快要' alone doesn't capture 'ready'

phrases.english: Yes, I want to learn Chinese with you today.
phrases.other: 是的，我今天想和你学中文。
phrases.qa_notes: Good structure, time placement correct

phrases.english: When I tried he was very patient with me.
phrases.other: 我试着的时候他对我很有耐心。
phrases.qa_notes: '我试着的时候' slightly awkward; '我试的时候' or '当我试的时候' more natural

phrases.english: We have already thanked her for everything she did this afternoon.
phrases.other: 我们已经感谢她今天下午做的。
phrases.qa_notes: Missing '一切/所有' for 'everything'. '今天下午做的' alone is incomplete/unclear

phrases.english: They do not want to let me do this alone.
phrases.other: 他们不想让我一个人做这个。
phrases.qa_notes: Excellent, natural Chinese causative construction with 让

phrases.english: come back together
phrases.other: 一起回来
phrases.qa_notes: Perfect, natural phrase with correct adverb placement

phrases.english: I want to learn something new before the weekend.
phrases.other: 我想周末之前学一些新的东西。
phrases.qa_notes: Good, minor preference: '在周末之前' might be slightly more natural

phrases.english: Would you mind waiting for just a few minutes at that place for me?
phrases.other: 你介意在那个地方等我几分钟吗？
phrases.qa_notes: Natural, polite request structure with 介意...吗

phrases.english: I am so happy that you are doing so well with Chinese.
phrases.other: 我很高兴你中文做得这么好。
phrases.qa_notes: '中文做得好' is unnatural collocation. Should be '你中文说得这么好' or '你中文学得这么好'

phrases.english: suffix (diminutive)
phrases.other: 儿
phrases.qa_notes: Grammar point explanation. Appropriate teaching item for erhua suffix

phrases.english: But he does not want to stop quickly, he wants to speak more.
phrases.other: 但是他不想快点停止，他想说。
phrases.qa_notes: '他想说' incomplete for 'wants to speak more'. Should add 更多 or use 多说

phrases.english: I believe this method is very good for helping us learn.
phrases.other: 我相信这个方法对帮我们学很好。
phrases.qa_notes: Slightly awkward. '对帮助我们学习很好' or '对我们学习很有帮助' more natural

phrases.english: Tell me something else.
phrases.other: 告诉我别的。
phrases.qa_notes: Natural, concise imperative

phrases.english: That is not as interesting as what she was saying.
phrases.other: 那没有她在说的那么有意思。
phrases.qa_notes: Excellent comparative structure with 没有...那么, progressive 在

phrases.english: That man will tell me something about the problem.
phrases.other: 那个男人会告诉我问题的东西。
phrases.qa_notes: '问题的东西' is unnatural for 'something about the problem'. Should be '关于问题的事' or '问题的情况'

phrases.english: We are trying to find more interesting things to do together.
phrases.other: 我们在找更多有趣的事一起做。
phrases.qa_notes: Good progressive 在 + verb structure, natural word order

phrases.english: I feel good about it starting to feel easier now.
phrases.other: 我对它开始觉得更容易很喜欢。
phrases.qa_notes: MAJOR ISSUE: Very awkward/unnatural sentence structure. English-influenced, grammatically confused

phrases.english: She said this is not possible for her to do today at all now
phrases.other: 她说这个她今天现在不可做
phrases.qa_notes: MAJOR ISSUE: Missing punctuation, '不可做' is ungrammatical. Should be '做不了' or '不能做'. '今天现在' redundant

phrases.english: Because I like feeling that I can meet people who speak Chinese.
phrases.other: 因为我喜欢感觉我能见说中文的人。
phrases.qa_notes: '喜欢感觉' is awkward. Better: '喜欢能遇到说中文的人的感觉' or restructure

phrases.english: The surprise was that my friend came to see me today.
phrases.other: 惊喜是我的朋友今天来见我。
phrases.qa_notes: Acceptable but slightly stiff. '令我惊喜的是' might be more natural

phrases.english: She thinks learning by herself is important and fun.
phrases.other: 她觉得自己学很重要很有趣。
phrases.qa_notes: Good, natural conjunction with 很...很...

phrases.english: You can often speak with my friend because she can help.
phrases.other: 你可以经常跟我朋友说话因为她可以帮你。
phrases.qa_notes: Good, natural structure with 跟...说话 and causal 因为

phrases.english: Before I met you I thought things were different.
phrases.other: 以前我见你我以为东西是不同的。
phrases.qa_notes: '以前我见你' should be '在我见到你以前' or '认识你以前'. '东西' (things) inappropriate here; should be '事情'

phrases.english: There are too many ideas in my head to think about.
phrases.other: 我脑子里有太多想法要想。
phrases.qa_notes: Natural, good structure with locative 脑子里

phrases.english: She said learning isn't easy but it's very important.
phrases.other: 她说学不容易但是很重要。
phrases.qa_notes: Good, natural reported speech with adversative 但是

phrases.english: I think there is no big issue when we work together.
phrases.other: 我觉得我们一起工作的时候没有大问题。
phrases.qa_notes: Natural sentence structure with time clause 的时候

phrases.english: That young man said the work was fairly bad.
phrases.other: 那个年轻的男人说工作挺差的。
phrases.qa_notes: Natural, colloquial 挺...的 pattern for 'fairly'

phrases.english: I am trying hard to learn Chinese, and it will happen.
phrases.other: 我在努力试着学中文，而且会发生。
phrases.qa_notes: '会发生' for 'it will happen' doesn't collocate well. '会成功' or '会实现' better

phrases.english: We are ready to get on the next bus when it comes here.
phrases.other: 我们准备好上下一班车它来这里的时候。
phrases.qa_notes: MAJOR ISSUE: Very English-influenced. Time clause must come first: '下一班车来的时候我们准备好上车。' Current structure ungrammatical

phrases.english: This afternoon he wanted to think about it carefully.
phrases.other: 今天下午他想仔细想它。
phrases.qa_notes: Time placement correct. '想它' slightly unnatural; '仔细想想这件事' better

phrases.english: Do you have some time to meet with me tomorrow afternoon?
phrases.other: 你明天下午有点时间和我见面吗？
phrases.qa_notes: '有点时间' slightly off; '有时间' or '有一点时间' better. Time placement correct

phrases.english: Of course I am grateful that you came to help us today.
phrases.other: 当然我很感谢你今天来帮我们。
phrases.qa_notes: Natural, good structure with 感谢 + clause

phrases.english: She said she wants to try different interesting things.
phrases.other: 她说她想做不同的有趣的事。
phrases.qa_notes: English says 'try' but Chinese says '做' (do). Minor translation accuracy issue

phrases.english: At the moment he didn't start to feel tired after studying.
phrases.other: 现在他学了没开始感觉累。
phrases.qa_notes: Awkward word order. Should be '现在他学了以后还没开始感觉累' or restructure

phrases.english: result complement
phrases.other: 得
phrases.qa_notes: Grammar point explanation. Appropriate teaching item for result complement marker

phrases.english: He thinks showing things is important for learning.
phrases.other: 他觉得给人看东西对学很重要。
phrases.qa_notes: '给人看东西' acceptable but slightly awkward for 'showing things'

phrases.english: But we are looking forward to helping everyone speak better.
phrases.other: 但是我们期待帮别人说得更好。
phrases.qa_notes: '期待' + verb structure good. Natural use of result complement 得

phrases.english: She does not believe that was a very good idea.
phrases.other: 她不相信那是个很好的主意。
phrases.qa_notes: Natural, correct measure word 个 for 主意

phrases.english: I will ask her where she wants to head tomorrow.
phrases.other: 我会问她明天想去哪里。
phrases.qa_notes: Natural, good embedded question structure with 哪里

phrases.english: They all came this morning to see us at this place.
phrases.other: 他们今天早上都来这个地方看我们。
phrases.qa_notes: Time placement good, 都 position correct after subject

phrases.english: I am not trying to remember a Chinese word now.
phrases.other: 我现在不在试着记住一个中文词。
phrases.qa_notes: Double negation awkward '不在试着'. Should be '我现在没在试着' or '我现在不是在试着'

phrases.english: What will you remember after the whole thing tomorrow?
phrases.other: 明天整个东西以后你会记住什么?
phrases.qa_notes: MAJOR ISSUE: '整个东西以后' very unnatural for 'after the whole thing'. Should be '整件事结束以后' or similar
